title: Axiomarium repo configuration
description: axiomarium.yaml at the repo root: how axm treats this repo. Every field is optional.

doctor.description: How axm doctor checks the repo.

ignore.description: Globs relative to the repo root for instruction files that are broken on purpose, such as test fixtures. The doctor doesn't list or check them, and says how many it left out. A trailing / covers everything under a folder.

evidence.description: The checks whose runs axm evidence records, such as tests, build and format.

checks.description: Each check, with the commands that count as running it and the files it vouches for. A declared check that never ran is MISSING.

name.description: The check's kebab-case name, unique in the repo, such as tests. Its latest run is kept as .axm/evidence/<name>.json.

run.description: The commands that count as running the check. A command counts when it starts with one of them, word by word, so dotnet test --no-build counts for dotnet test.

items.description: A command's leading words, such as dotnet test. Never a compound command: one joined with &&, ||, ;, | or & has one exit code for several commands.

covers.description: Globs relative to the repo root for the files the check vouches for, such as src/**. Left out, it covers every file git sees: tracked, or untracked and not ignored. The repo's own .axm/ is never covered.
